camel_example: aliyun tdsr PackScene --region cn-hangzhou --SceneId L2omaCMmQZZkEg4p0000 --Type download --version 2020-01-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Packages scenario data. If the type parameter is set to download, the data is downloaded to your local device. If the type parameter is set to sync, the data is synchronized to your Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket. You must activate OSS before synchronization
description_zh: 打包场景数据，入参type为download可下载到本地，入参type为sync可可同步到自己的阿里云oss（前提是自己已开通）
kebab_example: aliyun tdsr pack-scene --scene-id L2omaCMmQZZkEg4p0000 --type download --region cn-hangzhou
name: PackScene

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
download: Downloads the data.
sync: Synchronizes the data
parameters.name: type

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The authentication diagnostic details returned when permission verification fails. The details include the authentication principal, operation, policy, and rejection cause
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The authentication operation that triggers the permission denied error. You can use this operation to troubleshoot the issue or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The identity identifier of the authentication principal. The display format varies for RAM users, RAM roles, and SSO federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the authentication principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type of the authentication principal, such as RAM user, RAM role, or SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic message for the permission denied error. An account administrator with the required permissions can decode this message to troubleshoot the rejection cause
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the permission denied cause. This parameter distinguishes between lack of explicit authorization and explicit denial
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that causes the permission denied error, such as control policy, session policy, or identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
